title: AetherRush: Cyber Brawler 3D
subtitle: Classic 90s Arcade 2.5D Beat 'Em Up with Godot 4 3D Graphics
description: Take back the neon-drenched streets of Aether City! Play as martial arts master Remy or acrobatic kickboxer Hannah across 6 adrenaline-fueled stages. Smash destructible crates, pick up weapons, execute cinematic overhand throws, and battle towering syndicate bosses with smooth gamepad controls and online 2-player co-op.
features: Dual Protagonists: Play as Remy (power puncher) or Hannah (speed & acrobatics)
6 Action-Packed Stages: Downtown Avenue, Neon Alleyway, Subway Rails, Rooftop Helipad, Cargo Docks & Syndicate Tower
Authentic Arcade Sound: Live human reaction voice lines and energetic funk-rock tracks
Full Gamepad Support: Plug-and-play with Xbox, PlayStation, and generic USB controllers
Online Multiplayer: Real-time room joining and state relay on the shared Inaayah Nakama cluster

requirements.cpu: Intel Core i3 / Apple M1 / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher
requirements.gpu: Vulkan 1.2 compatible graphics (Apple Silicon, GTX 960, Radeon RX 560)

changelog.title: Asset Streamlining & Godot 4.3 Engine Enforcement
changes: Purged 240MB+ of unused raw FBX models and redundant loose textures from repository
Permanently excluded raw 3D model sources from export presets to optimize download sizes
Enforced strict Godot 4.3 syntax validation in git pre-commit hooks and CI/CD pipelines
Documented comprehensive Godot 3 vs Godot 4 migration guidelines across AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, and .agents/rules/

changelog.title: Tween Callback Godot 4.3 Runtime Hotfix
changes: Fixed critical IntervalTweener crash on enemy entrances and boss spawns
Fixed combat VFX tween callback chaining on hit smacks, blood spray, and prop debris
Stabilized player pummel and throw animation sequences

changelog.title: Downtown Avenue Ground Alignment & Polished Camera System
changes: Fixed visual elevation on Downtown Avenue so shoes, trees, and items sit firmly on asphalt
Eliminated floating shadow gaps on all street props and characters
Resolved engine camera device continuity warnings on macOS Sonoma & Sequoia
Fixed SceneTree timer lifecycle to eliminate freed lambda capture logs on scene transitions

changelog.title: 6-Stage Full Campaign & Boss Grapple Mechanics
changes: Expanded campaign from 1 demo stage to 6 full 5-wave stages with unique themes
Added boss grapple immunity and high-impact bowling projectile mechanics for regular thugs
Enhanced Hannah animations with lead jab, right cross, high thrust kick and launcher
Introduced auto-intro attract mode with seamless return to title screen on keypress

changelog.title: Initial 3D Arcade Release
changes: Godot 4.3 3D side-scrolling beat 'em up engine launch
Integrated Nakama WebSocket relay for 2-player online brawling
Destructible crates and barrels with consumable food drops

title: Kettle Court
subtitle: Cozy Medieval Marketplace Digital Board & Table Game
description: Step into the bustling fairgrounds of Kettle Court! Gather your coin pouch and merchant honors in a lively medieval marketplace digital table game. Claim artisan stalls across Bakery Row, Candle Row, and Harbor Row, draw from the communal Weather Deck, bid at town auctions, and share hot kettle stipends with 2 to 5 players over instant edge multiplayer.
features: 40-Step Village Square: Trade across 7 artisan districts including Bakery Row, Herb Row, and Harbor Row
Weather Deck Mechanics: Draw Sun, Drizzle, Gust, and Downpour cards that alter district commerce and fees
No Player Elimination: Even with an empty coin pouch, merchants stay in the court and recover on kettle stipends
Instant Web Play: Powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects for zero-download, low-latency multiplayer rooms

changelog.title: Matchmaking Latency & Unit Balancing
changes: Decreased packet synchronization delay over WebSocket
Balanced mid-lane court defender health pools
Integrated cloud profile syncing

title: Sundered Depths
subtitle: Co-Op Endless Horde Survival Dungeon Crawler
description: Descend shoulder-to-shoulder into the Sundered Depths! Fight off escalating 360-degree enemy swarms across multi-floor dungeons, conquer varying floor objectives, slay ancient dungeon lords, collect powerful relics and equipment chests, and restore the Grand Seal in high-octane local and online co-op.
features: Dual Co-Op Modes: Play locally on couch with Dynamic Shared Camera or Split-Screen, or online via Inaayah Nakama relay
5 Mastered Classes: Swordsman, Axe Fighter, Archer, Mage, Rogue with primary, melee defensive fallback, dash, and room-clearing ultimate
Dynamic Floor Objectives: Procedurally assigned survival surges, kill quotas, runic keystone hunts, obelisk charges, and boss duels
3 Escalating Dungeons: The Vermin Catacombs, The Abyssal Foundry, and The Cursed Necropolis with unique bosses
Rich Loot & Boon System: 10 in-run boon card upgrades, randomized equipment chests (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary), and power-up drops
Lore Codex & Bestiary: Floor-by-floor story chapters, comprehensive monster threat profiles, and 25 achievements

requirements.cpu: Quad-Core Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 / Apple M1 or higher

changelog.title: Initial Release of Sundered Depths
changes: Co-Op horde survival gameplay with dual local (shared camera & split-screen) and online multiplayer
5 hero classes with melee combat defense fallbacks for ranged units
Multi-floor dungeon progression with Broodmother, Ignis, and Lich King bosses
Procedural floor objectives, in-run boon leveling, equipment drops, and complete Lore Codex

title: Cyber Tactics: Syndicate Wars
subtitle: Turn-Based Sci-Fi Squad Tactics in the Aether Universe
description: Lead an elite cell of cybernetic mercenaries fighting corporate supremacy in turn-based tactical combat. Customize cyberware implants, flank armored enforcers, hack automated defenses, and extract with high-value syndicate data.
features: Tactical Cover System: Full and half cover with destructible environments
Cyberware Augmentations: Overclock speed, optical camouflage, and neuro-shock
Shared Universe: Set in the same world and syndicate underworld as AetherRush

changelog.title: Closed Alpha Preview Build
changes: Initial tactical grid movement prototype
Unit class balance: Infiltrator, Heavy, Hacker, Combat Medic
